scope: Every file under data/, including raw responses, normalized data, CSV exports, manifests, staging, and derived views.

categories.retention: Keep all FIRMS source CSVs and one compact canonical detection representation.
Keep WFIGS/IRWIN revision deltas, FEDS, CWFIS active fires, and Fire M3 perimeters; exclude redundant Fire M3 hotspots.
Keep only selected fire-mask/QA/geolocation source pairs and compact coverage tiles; never keep an unpaired fire or geolocation asset.
Keep issued HRRR/HRDPS fire-context tiles and source metadata for a fixed, predeclared variable and lead-time set.
Keep compact ETOPO context blocks and at most one immutable CEC NALCMS source archive per country release; prohibit extracted TIFF copies and categorical grids before target semantics are fixed.
Keep compact model-ready partitions. These are the only automatically evictable outputs after their lineage is verified.
Reserve for manifests, atomic staging, retries, and filesystem overhead.
